rounds.text: Amkay Products Ltd trades at a moderate P/E of 18.7x and a modest price-to-book ratio of 1.64x based on a price of ₹ 50.0 against a book value of ₹ 30.5 [E1, E2]. Beneath historical stagnation, tangible inflection signs have emerged: compounded profit growth over the last 3 years accelerates to 21%, outperforming the sector median profit growth of 20.7% [E12, E51]. Recent operational performance further validates this turnaround, evidenced by year-on-year sales growth of 14%, a confirmed multi-year sales uptrend, and recent momentum where profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 10% [E37, E43, E44]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months has slowed by -8%, 5-year sales growth is flat at 1%, and the current dividend yield is 0.00% [E4, E8, E13]. Nevertheless, the stock currently sits deep in its 52-week range at just 25% of its high, offering an attractive entry point for an enterprise demonstrating accelerating medium-term profitability [E5, E12].
